page.overview:
What is My World?

My World is the sixth track off of Metallica's eighth studio album, St. Anger. It was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, Kirk Hammett, and Bob Rock.

The subject matter of the song is about James Hetfield's battles with anger, addiction, and therapy. It highlights his fear of losing who he is while trying to change. The lyrics, like "The motherfuckers got in my head / Trying to make me someone else instead," show the struggle between outside pressures and his true self. This song is part of a bigger story on the album about therapy, showing how he first resisted and fought to take back control of his mind from those who wanted to "fix" him.

"My World" has never been performed live.
